correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite fields, classify subalgebras by a projected symplectic subspace and a central-or-graph lift, then prove spanning is exactly projected adjacency. Verify Lagrangian complements via symmetric forms (q³) and nondegenerate complements via determinant -1 (q(q²-1)); compute all five degrees and vertex multiplicities, including q even. The standalone brute-force checker enumerates every proper Lie subalgebra over F2 and F3 and computes adjacency from brackets without using the quotient criterion, matching all predicted degrees.
